responsibilities: Built Spring Boot microservices on SAP BTP (Cloud Foundry) using SAP Cloud SDK for Java, Destination service and XSUAA for secure S/4 connectivity; implemented retry/circuit-breaker and unit/integration tests.
Containerized spring microservices for Kyma runtime (Kubernetes) and automated image builds; implemented health checks, readiness probes and k8s manifests for microservice scaling.

Designed and implemented RESTful OData APIs (SAP Gateway) consumed by Spring microservices and Salesforce integrations; owned API contract, authentication, and schema versioning for 6 endpoints used by 3 downstream services (~10k requests/day).

Optimized S/4 HANA Open SQL queries by refactoring CDS views and stored procedures, cutting average query latency from 220ms to 161ms for reporting workloads and lowering DB cost due to fewer cold scans.
Participated in a firm initiative to transition Ascend Build to GPT-5 and implemented RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) pipeline that indexes ABAP templates for context-aware code generation.
Migrated the prompt library, updated retriever/schema, and added CI gates and naming/static-analysis validators.
Built event-driven interfaces (SAP PI/PO) to process real-time transactions; implemented idempotency and retry logic reducing duplicate transactions and improving end-to-end success rate.

Improved front-end performance by debouncing and paginating fetch calls in React; reduced API calls by 32% and average page TTFB by 20ms — lowered client CPU spikes on mobile devices and improved perceived UX.
Revamped indexing to reduce compute cost of get requests to the server and improving latency by 20ms.
Worked on 5+ pages to make the UI/UX responsive for mobile and tablet displays.
Helped migrate student record log from MongoDB to DynamoDB (AWS).

projects.name: Chat App
projects.description: A live real-time chat application that allows one to one as well as group communication with secure authentication.
highlights: Secure authentication implemented with one way password hashing with bcrypt and JWTs used to store auth data in browser.
MongoDB used to store user, chat and message data.
Used Chakra UI for User Interface and design, and context API for state management.

projects.name: Linear-Algebra Pro
projects.description: High-performance linear algebra and ML platform with 25+ REST endpoints, numerical core, and interactive Next.js visualization client.
highlights: Designed and implemented 25+ REST endpoints (Matrix CRUD, arithmetic, PCA/SVD/QR, eigenvalue solvers, ML train/predict/history) with typed DTOs and Swagger/OpenAPI documentation.

Built a high-performance numerical core: an immutable matrix engine plus algorithms (power iteration, SVD, QR, PCA) with explicit attention to memory and convergence for large matrices (guidance for matrices >1000×1000).
Implemented gradient-based ML pipelines (SGD / Momentum / Adam), model persistence, prediction endpoints, and loss-curve telemetry to support model debugging and visualization.
Delivered an interactive Next.js client for matrix construction, advanced operations, model training, and visualization (loss charts & knowledge/explainers), integrating seamlessly with the API.
Ensured reliability with Jest unit tests and E2E suites, strict validation/error handling, and clear API error messages for developer UX.
Productionized the stack: Dockerized services, environment-driven configs, and deployment patterns for local and cloud (Vercel client + Docker backend).
Focused on observability and developer ergonomics: Swagger UI, modular code organization (Matrix / Advanced / ML modules), and testable numeric primitives.

projects.name: URL Shortener
projects.description: Production-ready URL Shortener built with Spring Boot 3, Java 21, and PostgreSQL.
highlights: Secure slug generation (random or custom) with hit tracking, expirations, and redirects.
Clean REST API surface plus Swagger UI for quick testing and onboarding.
Docker Compose workflow spins up PostgreSQL (and the app) with a single command.
Profiles for dev/test keep H2-powered tests fast while mirroring prod schema.
Configurable base URL + slug length via env vars for multi-environment deployments.
